`probe.ttf`: JetBrains Mono Regular cut to "A" and space and renamed "Gallery Probe" (a family no other gallery font has), for the G4 test. SIL OFL 1.1 (`OFL.txt`).

`probe-mono.ttf`: the same font named "JetBrains Mono" (the bundled subset's family), for S-L1's test: a host's
font with a bundled family wins over the bundled one. Renamed with fonttools 4.55.0 (name IDs that held "Gallery Probe").
